summary: inXile Entertainment's story-heavy science-fantasy RPG and spiritual successor to Planescape: Torment, set in Monte Cook's Numenera universe.

entries.title: Torment: Tides of Numenera

emulation.notes: Use native PC rather than emulating console versions.

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route for the full game; console and other desktop releases have no documented exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release through Steam/GOG or another current storefront; use official support resources if compatibility tweaks are needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Immortal/collector-style editions add digital extras rather than documented exclusive in-game story content; no remaster with exclusive gameplay content is documented.
